methodBoundary: All prior residual names remained embargoed from HD6 Pass A and primary Pass B. Cross-mapping occurs only after source lock, primary theory coding, independent coding, confirmation-bias audit and three-treatment replay were frozen.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Temporal durability is a distinct validation axis
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Initial technical utility or deployment can coexist with later cycle-life, environmental, economic or safety failure.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Latent option value after declared-objective failure
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Failed OSI/FGCS and delayed neural-network work retain component, conceptual or later option value without retroactively satisfying their original objective.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Useful intervention can precede complete causal ontology
priorResidualFollowup.reading: The HD6 frozen corpus does not provide a sufficiently clean new source-native instance; prior recurrence remains intact but is not incremented merely to preserve a trend.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Deadline-conditioned frontier value
priorResidualFollowup.reading: IBM PC schedule pressure, coordinated protocol transition, and delayed irreversible environmental risk again make time-to-effect part of the objective rather than a side cost.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Parallel redundancy under high-consequence uncertainty
priorResidualFollowup.reading: HD6 contains competing routes but not a clean enough case of deliberately funded/materially different parallel redundancy to increment recurrence.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Platformization shifts the bottleneck from principle to reproducibility/yield/interfaces
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Once a principle works, bottlenecks repeatedly migrate into optimization, interfaces, automation, manufacturing and ecosystem complements.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Evaluator handoff across lifecycle phases
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Laboratory, safety, manufacturing, deployment and regulatory evaluators own different lifecycle claims; success under one does not grant authority to the next.

hd6NewResiduals.name: Open-interface diffusion trades owner control for complement breadth
hd6NewResiduals.reading: Open or published interfaces can accelerate complement ecosystems while reducing the initiating owner’s control. Current evidence is concentrated in computing and may collapse into R1/R4/R7/R8 rather than deserve an independent stable structure.

promotionGate: No structure is promoted in HD6. R1-R8 remain HD9-review candidates despite six-epoch recurrence. HD4-N1 newly meets a three-epoch eligibility threshold but remains unpromoted. Recurrence is incremented only when the frozen HD6 corpus supplies a clean instance; HD2-N3 and HD4-N2 are deliberately not incremented.
worldModelReading: HD6 strengthens recurrence evidence while simultaneously weakening confidence in the current taxonomy as a stable measurement basis. The correct update is selective recurrence plus measurement contraction, not eight-law promotion.
